label: Push to talk
title: Hold to speak, and release to write the text. Or click to start, and click again to write the text.
titleRecording: Listening… release the button to write the text
titleLatched: Listening… click the button again to write the text
recordingInWorkspaceTab: You cannot record: the tab “{tab}” of the workspace “{workspace}” is recording.
recordingElsewhere: You cannot record: another composition bar is recording.
titleWaiting: Waiting for Whisper, which changes the speech of another composition bar into text…
titleModelMissing: The Whisper model is not on this computer. Open Settings, Voice input, to download it.
error.microphone_denied: macOS refused the microphone. Open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Microphone, and turn on Heidrun Code. Then press the button again.
error.no_signal: Heidrun Code hears nothing from the microphone. If macOS just asked for the permission, press the button again. Otherwise open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Microphone, and turn on Heidrun Code.
error.no_microphone: Heidrun Code finds no microphone on this computer.
error.model_missing: The Whisper model is not on this computer. Open Settings, Voice input, to download it.
error.model_load_failed: Whisper could not read the model file. Download the model again in Settings, Voice input.
error.other: The voice input failed. Press the button again.
